WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb,
        AVG(1.0 * l.UN / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.SEX) <> ''
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_averages AS (
    SELECT
        SEX,
        AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb,
        AVG(avg_un_tbil_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
    GROUP BY SEX
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT *, AVG(avg_alb) OVER () AS mean_sex_avg_alb
    FROM sex_averages
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    avg_alb,
    avg_un_tbil_ratio,
    avg_alb - mean_sex_avg_alb AS alb_above_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE avg_alb > mean_sex_avg_alb;

assumptions.assumption: Each patient-level UN/T-BIL figure is the average of per-test ratios; rows with missing UN or T-BIL, or T-BIL equal to zero, are excluded from that average. Sex-level averages weight each patient equally, and the comparison mean is the unweighted mean across sexes with a non-missing ALB average.
